about_the_game:
A Handmade Game With Challenging, Innovative Gameplay

Build your vocabulary, outwit an AI, and test your linguistic skills in this adult word game. Every round is a new mental workout—build, decode, and define your way to victory with hand-crafted visuals scanned from in-house made physical assets.

Two Modes of Play

  • Tile-Build Rounds

    • Like other word games, but with less limits: you’re given as many tiles of a letter set as you want—and one “blank” tile you can reuse as any single letter infinite times. Your goal: find five words that use the rarest letters the most before time runs out.

  • Definition Rounds

    • Put your knowledge of English to the test. In this round, you choose between one real definition and three AI-generated definitions. Spot the truth; do you know better than the AI?

    • Every round you get a unique set of definitions. The AI tends to have patterns, though, so the right answer will often stand out.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Hand-Built, Authentic Art: Every asset in the game—tiles, backgrounds, UI elements—is either 3D-scanned from real-world objects or hand-drawn.

  • Replayability: With thousands of possible letter combinations and an ever-evolving pool of AI-generated definitions, each session is unique. No two games are ever the same.

  • Brain-Boosting Fun: Whether you’re a crossword veteran, a Scrabble champ, or simply someone who loves word puzzles, this game offers a fresh twist to challenge and build your creativity and vocabulary.

name: OneMore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card (DirectX 12 is recommended for better performance)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.
